def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ---- Only information available strictly before seed_time ----

    # Order items: ts is the purchase moment of the order
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    if len(oi_hist) == 0:
        final = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        final["has_any_sales"] = 0
        final["total_units"] = 0
        return final.fillna(0)

    # Orders: keep only orders purchased before seed_time.
    # Note: order_status may be updated AFTER seed_time (e.g. delivered later),
    # so we do NOT use order_status as a feature to avoid leakage.
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]

    oi_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_hist,
        orders_hist[["order_id", "customer_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )

    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    # ------------------------------
    # ALL-TIME HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    prod_all = oi_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    prod_all["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["avg_units_per_order"] = prod_all["total_units"] / prod_all["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ------------------------------
    # WINDOWED HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_30 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_30]
    prod_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    oi_90 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_90]
    prod_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers_90d=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        last_purchase_90d=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()
    prod_90["days_since_last_purchase_90d"] = (seed_time - prod_90["last_purchase_90d"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    oi_180 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_180]
    prod_180 = oi_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_180d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_180d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_180d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    # ------------------------------
    # TREND FEATURES (weekly units over last 90 days)
    # ------------------------------
    trend = oi_90.copy()
    trend["week"] = ((seed_time - trend["ts"]).dt.days // 7)
    trend_agg = trend.groupby(["product_id", "week"]).agg(
        units=("order_id", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    # weeks 0-2 (recent) vs weeks 10-12 (older, within 90d)
    recent = trend_agg[trend_agg["week"] < 3].groupby("product_id")["units"].sum().rename("units_recent_3w")
    older = trend_agg[(trend_agg["week"] >= 10) & (trend_agg["week"] <= 12)].groupby("product_id")["units"].sum().rename("units_older_3w")
    trend_df = pd.concat([recent, older], axis=1).reset_index()
    trend_df["units_recent_3w"] = trend_df["units_recent_3w"].fillna(0)
    trend_df["units_older_3w"] = trend_df["units_older_3w"].fillna(0)

    # ------------------------------
    # REVIEW FEATURES (reviews written before seed_time only)
    # ------------------------------
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    oi_reviews = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id", "ts"]],
        reviews_hist[["order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title", "review_comment_message"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    if len(oi_reviews) > 0:
        oi_reviews["has_comment"] = (
            oi_reviews["review_comment_title"].notna() | oi_reviews["review_comment_message"].notna()
        ).astype(int)
        review_features = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
            max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
            std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
            frac_reviews_with_comment=("has_comment", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        review_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])

    # ------------------------------
    # PAYMENT FEATURES (payments known before seed_time only)
    # ------------------------------
    payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    oi_payments = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        payments_hist[["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    if len(oi_payments) > 0:
        payment_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            avg_payment_value_per_item=("payment_value", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
            num_unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
        ).reset_index()
        dummies = pd.get_dummies(oi_payments["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type").astype(float)
        oi_pay_d = pd.concat([oi_payments[["product_id"]], dummies], axis=1)
        pay_agg = oi_pay_d.groupby("product_id").sum()
        payment_type_features = pay_agg.reset_index()
    else:
        payment_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])
        payment_type_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])

    # ------------------------------
    # MERGE ALL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features = prod_all.copy()
    for part in (prod_30, prod_90, prod_180, trend_df, review_features,
                 payment_features, payment_type_features):
        if len(part) > 0:
            all_features = pd.merge(all_features, part, on="product_id", how="left")

    # ------------------------------
    # DERIVED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features["has_any_sales"] = (~all_features["total_units"].isna()).astype(int)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_180d_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units_180d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = np.where(
        all_features["total_orders"] > 1,
        (all_features["days_since_first_purchase"] - all_features["days_since_last_purchase"]) / (all_features["total_orders"] - 1),
        0
    )
    all_features["recent_vs_older_units"] = all_features["units_recent_3w"] / all_features["units_older_3w"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ------------------------------
    # CLEAN AND REINDEX
    # ------------------------------
    datetime_cols = ["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_90d"]
    all_features = all_features.drop(columns=[c for c in datetime_cols if c in all_features.columns], errors="ignore")
    # ensure numeric
    for c in all_features.columns:
        if c != "product_id":
            all_features[c] = pd.to_numeric(all_features[c], errors="coerce")

    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)

    count_cols = [c for c in final_features.columns if (
        c.startswith("total_") or c.startswith("num_") or c.startswith("units_") or
        (c.startswith("pay_type_"))
    )]
    other_cols = [c for c in final_features.columns if c not in count_cols and c != "has_any_sales"]

    final_features["has_any_sales"] = final_features["has_any_sales"].fillna(0)
    if count_cols:
        final_features[count_cols] = final_features[count_cols].fillna(0)
    if other_cols:
        final_features[other_cols] = final_features[other_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features = final_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)

    return final_features
